title: Writing 写作
paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
prompt: Directions: Suppose the student union of your university is collecting students' opinions on whether the university library should be open to the general public. Write a letter to the student union. In your letter you should: 1) state your opinion clearly; 2) give reasons for your opinion; 3) make one or two practical suggestions. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference:
Dear members of the Student Union,

I am writing to share my opinion on whether our library should open its doors to the public.

On balance I support a careful opening. The library holds more than a million books, and many of them are never touched by students, while people in the neighbourhood have almost nowhere to study. Allowing readers from outside would also help the university share what public money has paid for, and it might encourage our own students to take the library more seriously.

I do not think a free, unconditional opening would work. During exam weeks, seats are already hard to find. I suggest a trial period of two months, with public readers registering for a card, borrowing limited to three books, and the reading rooms on the third and fourth floors kept for students. If the trial creates problems, the arrangement can be reviewed.

Thank you for collecting our views.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
